_comment: Listed pre-Reforged rune patches (DESIGN.md 0, 1.4, 3.2), oldest first. Hand-maintained; seeded from the research runes-legacy/changed-patches.json and reconstructed/prov-*.json. Read by generate-runes-data.js and tools/build-registry.js.

patch: Riot's patch name. season: patches.seasonOf(patch). reason: season-start | change | season-end, plus "+change" on a season boundary that also changes the catalog. A season-start / season-end without +change has the same catalog as the previous listed patch (C2), unless `noise` names the noise items (data/patches/noise/runes.json) that make up the whole difference.

source: the base catalog, {ddragon: <build>} = data/sources/runes/ddragon/<build>.json, {wiki: <name>} = data/sources/runes/wiki/<name>.json. sources: citations for the reason itself (G4). changes: what changed against the previous listed patch, each with sources and confidence. notes: other facts for a later patch-notes panel (client tooltip mistakes, data decisions); never shown by the calculator.
confidence: of the catalog as a whole; "low" adds (approx.) to the label. The label and tag come from patches.labelFor('runes', record) (curated tags and season tags in seasons.json).

notes.text: First rune state that can be reconstructed (D2): the runes page starts here, not at the V1.0.0.32 launch. Before V1.0.0.63 the notes give only percentages and no table survives.

Client look (not data): the earliest rune-page capture is September 2010 (YouTube Yq2BRjZSoX8, 2010-09-11). V1.0.0.63-V1.0.0.94(b) (December 2009 - June 2010) reuse that 2010 sheet head, tier filter and tooltip (css/air-sheet.css 7b, css/runes-legacy.css A8); an evidence gap.

Catalog as of V1.0.0.63: AD-per-level runes +11.1%, attack speed runes +150%, magic penetration runes +13.6%, flat health runes -17.6%, armor and MR (also per level) -10%; Clarity seals obtainable. 2009 Snowdown event runes (2009-12-16 to 2010-01-06).

changes.text: Critical damage runes -10%; flat ability power runes +10%.
2010 Winter Games event runes (2010-02-12 to 2010-03-02), among them Seal of the Extreme (dodge).
Energy runes added: Meditation and Lucidity seals, Acumen and Sapience glyphs, Meditation and Acumen quintessences.

notes.text: Season One started with V1.0.0.96 (2010-07-13) on this catalog, so V1.0.0.96 is not listed.

changes.text: Marks and Quintessences of Desolation armor penetration -15%; Marks, Glyphs and Seals of Strength attack damage +200%; Marks, Glyphs and Seals of Might attack damage per level +35%.
Limited-edition 2010 Harrowing quintessences: Piercing Screech, Bountiful Treats, Speedy Specter, Elusive Werewolf (dodge), Witches Brew, Headless Horseman.
Event rune only: Quintessence of the Headless Horseman armor penetration 3.62 -> 3.08.
Flat energy, energy per level and energy regen per level runes +10%; flat energy regen runes +5%.
Festive tier 3 event quintessences (2010 Snowdown Showdown): Frosty Fortitude, Sugar Rush, Piercing Present, Deadly Wreath.
Clarity runes (scaling mana regen seals and glyphs) about -33%; Quintessences of Fortitude (health) about -20%.
Event runes: Razer Mark of Precision and Razer Quintessence of Speed (2011 Razer PAX promotion codes, late August or September 2011; no patch, date approximate). Folded into V1.0.0.128 (D9).

notes.text: Last Season One patch (V1.0.0.129 starts Preseason 2). The research state is V1.0.0.124-V1.0.0.130; V1.0.0.124 is not listed (D9).
Preseason 2 (Season Two masteries); the rune catalog is unchanged from V1.0.0.128.

changes.text: New rune types: Destruction (hybrid armor and magic penetration marks and quintessences), Avarice seals (gold per 10 s), Endurance (% health seals and quintessences), Vampirism (life steal quintessences), Transmutation (spell vamp quintessences).
Greater Quintessence of Studio Rumble (tournament-only event rune, December 2011).
Dodge removed from the game: the Seals and Quintessences of Evasion and the dodge event runes (Elusive Snowflake, Extreme, Elusive Werewolf) are gone (refunded from 2011-12-16).
Marks of Warding MR -20%; Glyphs of Insight magic penetration +20%, Potency AP +20%, Warding MR -10%; Quintessences of Insight magic penetration +15%, Warding MR -11.1%.
Hotfix: Greater Quintessence of the Piercing Present now matches Greater Quintessence of Insight.
Runes renamed after their stat (for example Mark of Desolation -> Mark of Armor Penetration).
Armor penetration, magic penetration and hybrid penetration marks, glyphs and quintessences rebalanced (exact values in the patch notes).

notes.text: Client tooltip mistake, kept (D3): Greater Mark of Hybrid Penetration (5402) says +0.62 magic penetration; the stat, the wiki and the V1.0.0.152 notes give 0.61. It stays so until V7.21.
Quintessence of Destruction magic penetration before V1.0.0.152: the patch notes' "from" values 0.72/1.01/1.3 are used; the wiki rune table (December 2011 to November 2012) said 0.63/0.88/1.13.

changes.text: Cooldown Reduction and Scaling Cooldown Reduction runes increased at all tiers (2-35%); for example 9 Greater Glyphs of Scaling CDR 8.62% -> 10% at level 18.

notes.text: Source is Data Dragon 3.6.15, the first build Data Dragon has; the wiki reconstruction of V3.04 is the same catalog at calculator level (checked by tools/import-runes.js).

changes.text: Rune rework (39 runes, all tiers; the notes list only tier 3): Seals of Armor 1.41 -> 1 and Health 5.35 -> 8 (Greater), Scaling Armor, Scaling Health and HP5 seals up; Scaling CDR, Scaling MR, MP5 and Scaling MP5 glyphs up; Quintessences of CDR 1.67% -> 2.5%, Scaling CDR 2.5% -> 5%, Attack Speed 3.4% -> 4.5%, Life Steal 2% -> 1.5%.

notes.text: Also in this catalog against V3.14: the Life Steal quintessence text "Lifesteal" -> "Life Steal", and Greater Seal of Scaling Energy Regeneration 0.064 -> 0.0642 per level (Data Dragon added the stats block in V4.1; noise rn-002).
No rune data change in Season 5. V5.1 removed the Rune Combiner and changed store prices and availability (client and store only; the combiner is per-patch chrome, combinerOf).
Same stats as V5.22. The only difference is client text: since V6.5 Mark of Hybrid Penetration (5401) reads "+0.7 AMP / +0.48 MP" (noise rn-003), so this patch has its own catalog file.

changes.text: Preseason 7: flat armor penetration replaced by Lethality. Marks and Quintessences of Armor Penetration become Lethality (x1.25: 1.28 -> 1.6 and 2.56 -> 3.2 at tier 3), Hybrid Penetration becomes Precision, and the Headless Horseman and Deadly Wreath quintessences move to lethality (14 runes).

notes.text: Mark of Precision (5401): Data Dragon says "+0.7 Leth / +0.48 M.Pen", the stale armor-penetration number. The client data says +0.88 Lethality (0.7 x 1.25); runes-overrides.json ro-001 (text) and ro-003 (value) apply from V6.22 to V7.21 (D7).

Final pre-Reforged patch (V7.22 is Runes Reforged). From 7.3.1 on Data Dragon rounds the raw rune stats to 4 decimals with no patch note and unchanged tooltips; the full-precision 7.2.1 values are used (D8, ro-002), so V7.21 shares the V6.22 catalog. Without it, 9 Greater Glyphs of Scaling CDR would give 14.58% instead of 15% at level 18.
